title: Item Rename
description: Rename your items with colors and styles!
body:
# ItemRename
### A simple Mod that lets you Rename Items

To Rename a Item:

    /rename <Text>

To extend the Name:

    /rename add <Text>

### Style and Symbols
- Italic = <>
- Obfuscated = {}
- Bold = []
- Strickethrough = ()
- Underlined = /|
- Color = #XXXXXX <-HexCode

To make it easier, there's a Website where you can enter the Text and the Style and the Command are created automatically for you.

[The Website](https://widdermc.github.io/ItemRename/)

If you find any bugs or have any Datapack/Mod suggestions, please let me know on my [Discord](https://discord.gg/fy4KuxYKVD).
